name: CLMT
recent: CLMT 于 2026 年 11 月 26 日宣布拟以 7600 万林吉特收购槟城一座全面出租的物流资产。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）与退休基金局（KWAP）多次申报股权变动。公司 2026 财年第三季度净利同比增长 34.1%，并派发每单位 1.35 仙的股息。
notable: 拟以 7600 万林吉特向 Merbau Sejati Sdn Bhd 收购槟城一座综合设施（含生产与仓库及两层办公楼）。
2026 财年第三季度净利同比增长 34.1%，每单位派息 1.35 仙，同比增长 21.6%。
KWAP 与 EPF 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: KWAP 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动，需留意其持股变化。
EPF 于 2026 年 11 月 11 日申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 1.265 亿林吉特，同比增长 9.3%，环比增长 2.8%；净利为 4702 万林吉特，同比增长 34.1%，环比增长 6.9%；净利率为 37.2%，高于上一季度的 35.8%。

recent_en: CLMT announced on 26 November 2026 a proposed acquisition of a fully leased Penang logistics asset for RM76 million. Meanwhile, EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests. The company's 3QFY2026 net income rose 34.1% year-on-year, with a DPU of 1.35 sen per unit.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of an integrated facility (production and warehouse with a two-storey office) in Penang from Merbau Sejati Sdn Bhd for RM76 million.
3QFY2026 net income up 34.1% year-on-year; DPU of 1.35 sen, up 21.6% year-on-year.
KWAP and EPF filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between September and November 2026.
risks_en: KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests between September and November 2026; its shareholding changes warrant monitoring.
EPF filed a change in substantial shareholder interest on 11 November 2026.
earnings_en: 3QFY2026 revenue was RM126.54 million, up 9.3% year-on-year and 2.8% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM47.02 million, up 34.1% year-on-year and 6.9% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 37.2%, up from 35.8% in the previous quarter.
